root_cause: KnowledgeBase replaced unique persisted chunk identity with parent document_id before BM25/RRF, then projected metadata through a separate parent-id map.

positive_contract.candidate_identity: persisted document_id::chunk-N through vector, BM25 and RRF
positive_contract.parent_identity: stable document_id projected only after ranking
positive_contract.projection: content, chunk_id, chunk_index, title, score and ranks originate from the selected chunk
positive_contract.chunking: 360 estimated-token hard ceiling, structural boundary preference, 48-token overlap, oversized-sentence hard split
positive_contract.migration: v1 chunks remain queryable with aligned stored chunk IDs; original source documents must be reindexed to receive v2 overlap, and no silent rewrite is attempted

closure_status: Reviewer B evidence remains immutable; a fresh-context reviewer must independently re-run the multichunk invariant before this finding is closed.
